basics.name: Vicente Opaso
basics.label: Web Engineering Manager & Frontend Architect. Composable Platforms, Design Systems & Developer Experience. 15+ years delivering high-impact digital products.
basics.summary: I’m a Web Engineering Manager and Frontend Architect with 15+ years designing, scaling, and maintaining high-performance digital platforms across enterprise, e-commerce, and mission-critical environments. I specialize in composable architecture, Design Systems, and Developer Experience (DevEx)—aligning technology, design, and strategy to deliver accessible, performant, and maintainable products. I have led cross-functional teams, modernized CI/CD and code governance, and foster strong engineering culture through mentorship and Communities of Practice. My approach blends technical architecture with design empathy and operational discipline to unlock durable, business-aligned outcomes.

highlights.title: Web Engineering Manager at Nexthink
highlights.content: Led the architecture and delivery of nexthink.com, a global composable corporate website, while leading a cross-functional team focused on performance, accessibility, localization, and strategic alignment.

highlights.title: Technical Application Owner at EUROCONTROL
highlights.content: Lead frontend governance and modernization for aviation platforms (NMUI, EDS), aligning safety, compliance, and delivery at scale.

highlights.title: Design System Architect (EDS & Malty)
highlights.content: Drive UI consistency, accessibility, and reuse with enterprise-grade component libraries and contribution models.

highlights.title: Solutions Architect
highlights.content: For enterprise B2B platforms at Carlsberg Group (≥ €1B annual turnover) and global marketing frameworks.

highlights.title: CoP Builder
highlights.content: Found and scale Communities of Practice to raise standards, share knowledge, and improve DevEx.

highlights.title: Agile Leader
highlights.content: Guide cross-functional teams with iterative delivery, documentation, and measurable outcomes.

highlights.title: Digital Agency Co-founder
highlights.content: Delivered full-stack web and mobile solutions for Fortune 500 and public sector clients.

positions.summary: Led a 5-person cross-functional team—including a UI/UX Designer—behind nexthink.com, Nexthink's global composable web platform supporting brand, marketing, and product strategy. Focused on team structure, DevEx, and design–engineering collaboration to deliver reliable, scalable, and localized experiences.
highlights: Led a 5-person distributed team across EU/US/India; improved delivery consistency through DevEx automation and workflow standardization.
Integrated Vercel + GitHub + Hygraph pipelines, reducing release friction and improving deployment reliability.
Elevated Core Web Vitals across six localized markets by 25%.
Introduced governance (CodeQL, PR templates, branch protections) reducing production defects by 30%+.
Own architecture and delivery of a composable stack: Next.js, GraphQL, Tailwind CSS, Hygraph CMS—deployed on Vercel and tightly integrated with GitHub.
Implemented guardrails and governance: CodeQL, Copilot, branch protections, PR templates, and automated checks to raise code quality and reliability.
Integrate Vercel–GitHub–Hygraph workflows for faster, safer releases; standardize pipelines with GitHub Actions (CI/CD).
Managed a cross-functional team (3 developers, 1 UX designer) focused on performance, accessibility, maintainability, and content velocity.
Improve design ↔ development feedback loops with shared components, design tokens, and documentation for tighter iteration.
Coordinated localization and campaign delivery across six languages with brand, content, and demand-gen stakeholders.

positions.summary: Led frontend governance, team coordination, and modernization for aviation-critical systems at the Network Manager Operations Centre (NMOC). Coordinated a 10-person cross-functional team (engineers, designers, SM, PO, and QA) within a wider 20+ person development organization, bridging engineering, product, and regulatory stakeholders in a safety-critical environment.
highlights: Modernized frontend stack used by 5,000+ aviation stakeholders across Europe.
Modernized CI/CD pipelines and QA processes, reducing deployment friction by 40% and improving delivery reliability.
Re-architected legacy flows into modular components, reducing maintenance overhead by 30%.
Created the "Formal Thread" documentation framework, establishing engineering traceability across all UI workflows — reducing compliance review cycles for aviation-critical releases.
Provide technical leadership for NMUI (microfrontend framework) enabling multitasking and interoperability across mission-critical apps.
Guide the strategy and implementation of the EUROCONTROL Design System (EDS) for accessible, consistent UI/UX.
Led DevEx improvements: CI/CD modernization, automation, onboarding, and access management to streamline delivery across the team.
Act as technical liaison aligning architecture with operational readiness and compliance requirements.
Established improved documentation workflows and foundations for sustainable developer experience across teams.

positions.summary: Led the design and delivery of scalable Frontend Architectures for global B2B and marketing platforms, aligning engineering with commercial priorities and DevEx maturity.
highlights: Defined component architecture powering multiple brand sites across Western Europe.
Established DevEx workflows and onboarding documentation that improved ramp-up speed and cross-team consistency.
Introduced accessibility frameworks ensuring AA baseline across products.
Architected web platforms supporting €1B+ annual turnover across regions; improved performance, reliability, and accessibility.
Modernized CI/CD with GitHub Actions and feature toggles to reduce deployment friction and improve release cadence.
Defined documentation and onboarding workflows to increase transparency and consistency across distributed teams.
Partnered with design and marketing to align UX, compliance, and performance with brand and growth goals.
Member of Software Engineering Leadership Team, shaping standards and governance.

positions.position: Solutions Architect – Digital Marketing & Consumer Tech
positions.summary: Architected and delivered global marketing solutions (Cookie Consent, Age Gateway, Global Policies) using TypeScript/React and headless CMS (primarily Umbraco), balancing compliance, localization (i18n), and performance.
highlights: Implemented privacy/compliance frameworks deployed across markets (Cookie Consent, Age Gateway, Global Policy).
Built analytics integrations to improve data-driven decision making.
Aligned technology with brand and growth strategies across marketing, data, and product.
Delivered modular, secure architectures enabling multi-market scalability.

positions.position: Lead Developer & Architect – Malty Design System
positions.summary: Led the architecture, development, and adoption of Malty—an enterprise React/TypeScript Design System built with an inner-sourcing model. Scaled contribution, governance, and documentation to enable reuse across products.
highlights: Established governance, versioning, and contribution guidelines; integrated Figma + Storybook + CI/CD.
Standardized components and accessibility (WCAG 2.1) across B2B and consumer products.
Drove adoption across global teams with onboarding materials and documentation.

positions.summary: Owned delivery for key web apps across Carlsberg’s ecosystem, co-managing CarlShop+ (B2B, €1B+ revenue) and leading frontend for CADI (in-house CRM), while mentoring developers and improving delivery practices.
highlights: Co-managed the architecture and delivery of CarlShop+ (B2B, €1B+ revenue).
Led frontend for CADI CRM; ensured performance, data integrity, and security compliance.
Advanced Malty Design System and Lean Sign-up to streamline onboarding and UI consistency.

positions.summary: Joined Carlsberg’s Digital Team to co-create an internal Single-SPA microfrontend platform with TypeScript/React on AWS, and to establish CI/CD automation via GitHub Actions.
highlights: Co-created internal back-office Single-SPA platform with reusable boilerplates.
Implemented automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.
Kickstarted documentation for existing apps and platform standards.

positions.summary: Co-founded a digital studio delivering web and mobile platforms for enterprise and public-sector clients including General Motors, GO GROUND (NCAA), and the Paulson Institute. Oversaw engineering, UX, and delivery operations, mentoring a cross-functional team of designers and developers.
highlights: Defined and executed the technical and delivery strategy, ensuring high standards of performance, accessibility, and reliability.
Built and managed frontend and mobile teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership, and technical excellence.
Introduced CI/CD automation, documentation workflows, and QA processes, improving delivery consistency and maintainability.
Implemented agile delivery practices, aligning engineering execution with client goals and outcomes.
Led multi-phase projects exceeding $200K, balancing technical quality with business and stakeholder expectations.

positions.summary: Led a distributed team delivering a custom Angular-based healthcare platform. Oversaw UX, database design, and UI implementation. Managed client relations, documentation, and Agile delivery.
highlights: Designed a scalable Angular/TypeScript architecture with reusable components and documentation.
Led end-to-end delivery including sprint management, QA oversight, and stakeholder alignment.
Managed client communications and expectations, ensuring high satisfaction and on-time delivery.

positions.summary: Built and deployed A/B and multivariate experiments for global e-commerce clients. Improved engagement and conversion through UX iteration and analytics-driven design.
highlights: Developed high-performance test variants for web and mobile platforms.
Collaborated with analysts and product managers to align experiments with business goals.
Documented experiment logic, outcomes, and learnings for team knowledge sharing.

positions.summary: Delivered high-quality microsites and internal tools for clients like Hilton Hotels, Anheuser-Busch, and Omron. Focused on responsive, accessible, and SEO-optimized interfaces.
highlights: Led frontend implementation of a six-month internal platform for Hilton Hotels.
Built responsive microsites optimized for performance and accessibility.
Collaborated with designers and strategists to meet brand guidelines and technical standards.

positions.summary: Managed nationwide telecommunications deployments for clients like T-Mobile, AT&T, and Alascom. Directed engineering teams, ensured compliance, and maintained client relationships.
highlights: Delivered national rollout projects, including a $10M 4G deployment for T-Mobile.
Coordinated over 20 field crews and RF teams across multi-state surveys.
Maintained rigorous documentation and compliance with telecom standards.

references.name: Carlos Vicent Domenech | Site Reliability Engineer Lead @ Nexthink
references.reference:
I have had the chance to work twice in different companies with Vicente. On our first journey, working for Carlsberg, we were in two different teams responsible for different products/platforms. Vicente was responsible for the team handling the design and framework of the platform to onboard new markets for Carlaberg. They created Carlsberg Malty, an open-source design system to standarise components to be used in the different store-fronts and markets. As we travelled to Lisbon regularly to meet our colleagues in the Carlsberg Digital Hub, we always had time to chat and discuss technology in endless evenings and nights. These discussions opened us to understand different technical points of view and improved the understanding of the ongoing work from the different groups.

On our second journey, Vicente joined Nexthink as Web Engineering Manager. Despite the short period working with Vicente again, we retook conversations, going more into engineering management, key decisions and pain points in fast-growing teams. This indicates to me that leadership and the desire to excel at work are still strong skills Vicente possesses.

I'm reassuring my confidence with Vicente and his skills to lead the creation of platforms that improve the Developer Experience and accelerate the development and delivery of tangible products.

references.name: Peter Birkholm-Buch | Director of Software Engineering in Growth Products & Data @ Carlsberg Group
references.reference:
It has been a privilege to have Vicente as part of my Leadership Team at Carlsberg Group. As our Frontend Solutions Architect, Vicente played a critical role in shaping our frontend strategy, notably through the development of the Malty Design System, which has transformed how we approach global frontend solutions.

His technical expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Frontend technologies, combined with his leadership in establishing a Community of Practice, has greatly improved the developer experience and code quality across the organization. Vicente's contributions were instrumental in driving our e-commerce growth to over €1 billion annually.

I highly recommend Vicente for his leadership, creativity, and exceptional technical skills. He would be a tremendous asset to any team.

references.name: Razvan Margauan | iNM Programme Director @ EUROCONTROL
references.reference:
I had the chance to work closely with Vicente Opaso during my time leading the USER Domain at EUROCONTROL. Vicente played a key role in shaping the technical direction of both the NMUI framework and the Eurocontrol Design System (EDS), two major initiatives that supported our operational platforms.

He approached his responsibilities with clarity and consistency - whether it was aligning architectural work with regulatory requirements or improving developer workflows across teams. I particularly appreciated Vicente's ability to foster cross-functional collaboration, which made him a reliable contributor.

His work had a noticeable impact on the stability and scalability of our systems, and I appreciated his pragmatic, steady approach to solving technical challenges.

references.name: Samuel Silva | Senior Frontend Developer @ Carlsberg Group
references.reference:
Working alongside Vicente on various projects over the past two years has been an absolute pleasure. As a Solutions Architect, he consistently shows dedication in delivering excellent solutions that meet our business needs while valuing the team's expertise every step of the way.

Besides his technical skills, Vicente is a team player who creates a positive and collaborative work environment. He consistently goes above and beyond to support colleagues and shares his expertise within our company's internal community.

I highly recommend Vicente for any project in need of a talented and dedicated Solutions Architect. He brings abundant expertise, professionalism, and enthusiasm to every project.

references.name: Thiago Mota | Senior Product Designer @ Carlsberg Group
references.reference: Collaborating with Vicente Opaso, the Solutions Architect and Lead Developer for the Malty Design System at Carlsberg Group, was a testament to his extensive expertise and professionalism. Vicente brought a wealth of knowledge to our work on the Malty Design System. His deep expertise and unwavering professionalism were evident throughout our collaboration. Vicente's collaborative approach and ability to align technical intricacies with design aspirations made a significant impact, ensuring the scalability and success of the project. His commitment to excellence and adeptness in fostering collaboration make him a valuable asset in delivering robust solutions.

references.name: Bruno Torres | Senior Frontend Developer @ Carlsberg Group
references.reference:
It's with genuine pleasure that I share my admiration for Vicente, the incredibly talented Frontend Solutions Architect I had the chance to work with at Carlsberg. Working alongside him has been more than just a professional experience; it's been a journey of growth and camaraderie.

Vicente stands out for his technical prowess and his genuine commitment to building a tight-knit Frontend Community. Under his guidance, I've felt a sense of trust and support beyond the usual workplace dynamic. Vicente's efforts to create a collaborative environment have made our team feel like a family, fostering an atmosphere where everyone's contributions are valued.

As a Frontend Developer, I've greatly appreciated Vicente's approach to problem-solving and his emphasis on sharing knowledge. His mentorship has elevated my technical skills and made our workplace a positive and uplifting space.

I wholeheartedly recommend Vicente Opaso to anyone looking for more than just a leader – someone who values humanity and teamwork as much as technical excellence.
